thread:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT: High error rate (5xx) observed for citrine-corp dedicated pool in us-west-2. Affected tenant=citrine-corp, model-variant=redwood/claude-lite-2. Paging oncall.

oncall-alex: Ack — investigating. Pulling metrics and pool health now.

sam_h: Metric dump: spike started ~14:07 UTC. 5xx rose 0.2% -> 12% in ~3m. p95 latency x3. KV cache miss rate + burst of evictions. Short link: https://redwood.metrics/citrine/evictions

eng-runtime-lead: Likely eviction storm causing request failures. Recommend: 1) quarantine tenant to dedicated quarantine nodegroup, 2) pin tenant to a known stable safe variant (safe-v1), 3) temporarily disable autoscale on original pool to avoid thrash.

eng-runtime-lead: Command to pin model for tenant (internal API):

```http
POST /api/v1/tenants/citrine-corp/actions
Content-Type: application/json

{"action":"pin_model","model":"redwood/claude-lite-2","variant":"safe-v1","reason":"emergency fallback due to eviction storm"}
```

maria_ops: I'll notify the account team + customer-facing ops: "Citrine: we're mitigating elevated errors; responses may be degraded. We'll update in ~15m."

oncall-alex: Executing pin now via internal tooling. Running:
`/internal/tooling/tenant-pin --tenant citrine-corp --model redwood/claude-lite-2 --variant safe-v1`

incident-bot: Action logged: ticket #INC-2026 created, runbook 'dedicated-eviction' invoked.

oncall-alex: Pin completed. Routing switched to pinned variant on quarantine nodegroup. Observed error rate drop from 12% -> ~3% within 2m.

eng-runtime-lead: Next: scale quarantine nodegroup and lock autoscaler on original pool to prevent oscillation. Suggested commands:

```bash
# scale up quarantine nodes
kubectl scale --replicas=4 nodegroup/quarantine-citrine
# temporarily lock autoscaler (internal API)
curl -XPOST https://internal.api/autoscaler/lock -d '{"pool":"dedicated-usw2-citrine"}'
```

sam_h: After scale, p95 trending back to baseline. Will keep sampling traces and KV miss rates.

maria_ops: Notified customer. Customer asked: "Any data loss?" I replied: "No. We've switched to a stable safe variant and are monitoring. A postmortem will follow."

oncall-alex: Handoff to oncall-jordan for watch and post-incident tasks. Jordan, please monitor for 30m and coordinate PM updates.

oncall-jordan: Picked up. I'll watch logs and only schedule canary swap back after 30m stable and a short load test. :thumbsup:

eng-runtime-lead: Follow-up recommendation (RFC): add protective safeset that auto-pins to safe-v1 when eviction_rate > 5% for 2m, plus an operator alert for eviction storms.

oncall-alex: Closing pager for now; thread remains open for status updates.
